paper_title: Think Silently, Think Fast Dynamic Latent Compression of LLM Reasoning   Chains
caption: Performance of when implemented with base LLMs ranging from 1B to 8B parameters.

model_annotations.English: This plot illustrates the relationship between the compression factor and accuracy for three different Llama3 models with varying parameter sizes. The x-axis represents the compression factor (c), with a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 5, and tick labels at each integer value. The y-axis represents accuracy as a percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 30 to 70, and tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot displays three lines, each representing a different Llama3 model: Llama3-1B (brown, solid line with circle markers), Llama3-3B (maroon, solid line with circle markers), and Llama3-8B (purple, solid line with circle markers). The Llama3-1B line starts at around 48% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and decreases to around 27% at a compression factor of 5. The Llama3-3B line begins at approximately 63% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and declines to around 40% at a compression factor of 5. The Llama3-8B line starts at about 70% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and decreases to roughly 45% at a compression factor of 5. All three lines exhibit a steady downward trend as the compression factor increases.

Three lines are shown: the brown line, representing Llama3-1B, starts at around 48% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and decreases to approximately 27% at a compression factor of 5; the maroon line, representing Llama3-3B, begins at about 64% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and declines to roughly 40% at a compression factor of 5; the purple line, representing Llama3-8B, starts at approximately 70% accuracy at a compression factor of 1 and decreases to around 45% at a compression factor of 5. All three lines exhibit a declining trend as the compression factor increases, with no notable peaks or inflection points.
